reviews.comment: Everything about my experience at Grovewood felt thoughtful. The front desk was kind, my therapist listened without rushing me, and I left my first session feeling like I had a plan. Highly recommend.
The TMS team walked me through every step and checked in each week. I'm sleeping better and feel more like myself again. Grateful for the care.
Clean, calm office and easy scheduling. My appointments always start on time.
Really good experience overall. Wait for my first appointment was a little longer than I hoped, but the care once I was in was excellent.

I had been putting off getting help for years. The assessment was thorough, the explanations were clear, and I never felt judged. I'm so glad I finally made the call. The whole team has been warm and professional from the first phone call to every follow-up.
Had trouble getting a call back about billing.
My psychiatrist took the time to explain my options and answer every question. I never felt like just another appointment.
Good provider, but parking can be tricky at busy times.
Compassionate, professional, and organized. Telehealth worked smoothly for me.
Scheduling took a while and I felt unsure about next steps after my visit.
Five stars. The staff made a hard step feel manageable.
